sub_rqs.question: How effective are digital therapeutics at reducing depressive symptom severity in the short term compared with control conditions?
sub_rqs.rationale: Establishes the core post-treatment efficacy evidence base on which durability questions depend.
queries: digital therapeutics depression randomized controlled trial efficacy
internet-delivered cognitive behavioral therapy depressive symptoms meta-analysis
smartphone app intervention depression symptom reduction
prescription digital therapeutic major depressive disorder

sub_rqs.question: How long do reductions in depressive symptoms persist after digital intervention ends, based on follow-up assessments?
sub_rqs.rationale: Directly addresses the durability dimension of the topic through long-term follow-up evidence.
queries: digital intervention depression long-term follow-up sustained effect
internet CBT depression durability of treatment effects
digital mental health depression 12-month follow-up outcomes
relapse after computerized CBT depression

sub_rqs.question: How do effects and durability differ by intervention type, delivery format, and level of human support (guided vs. unguided)?
sub_rqs.rationale: Identifies design features of digital therapeutics that moderate effect size and persistence.
queries: guided versus unguided internet intervention depression effect
therapist support digital mental health intervention depression outcomes
app-based versus web-based depression intervention comparison
computerized CBT human support moderator effectiveness

sub_rqs.question: How do patient characteristics and clinical context (severity, comorbidity, primary care vs. community, adjunct vs. standalone use) moderate outcomes?
sub_rqs.rationale: Clarifies for whom and under which conditions digital therapeutics work and sustain benefit.
queries: moderators of digital intervention outcomes depression baseline severity
digital therapeutics adjunct to antidepressant treatment depression
eHealth intervention depression primary care effectiveness
digital CBT comorbid anxiety depression subgroup analysis

sub_rqs.question: How do engagement, adherence, and attrition relate to symptom improvement and its persistence?
sub_rqs.rationale: Engagement is a key mechanism and threat to real-world effectiveness and durability.
queries: adherence engagement digital depression intervention symptom improvement
dropout attrition internet-delivered depression treatment
dose-response app usage depressive symptoms
machine learning predict engagement mental health app

sub_rqs.question: What methodological limitations, placebo or attention-control effects, and adverse effects affect the interpretation of digital therapeutic evidence for depression?
sub_rqs.rationale: Assesses evidence quality and risks, tempering conclusions about effectiveness and durability.
queries: risk of bias digital mental health depression trials
placebo sham control digital therapeutic depression
negative effects deterioration internet interventions depression
real-world effectiveness digital mental health depression

search_strategy: Search 2010 to present, emphasizing systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and randomized controlled trials with adult or adolescent participants with depression or elevated depressive symptoms, plus regulatory-cleared prescription digital therapeutics studies. Exclude protocol-only papers, general wellness or prevention-only apps without depressive symptom outcomes, and non-digital telehealth that is purely video therapy. Expect rq2 (durability beyond 12 months) and rq6 (adverse effects and sham-controlled designs) to be the thinnest in the literature.
